newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ningxia Paper plans to issue 54 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Ningxia Paper plans to issue 54 mln A shares.

text.p: Ningxia Meili Paper Industry (Group) Co Ltd plans to launch an offer of 54 million A shares this year, a company spokesman said on Friday.
The company has not determined where it will apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list the shares, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Meili will also apply for a simultaneous offer of six million staff shares, which will not be listed until six months after the listing of the A shares, the official said.
The firm is in the process of selecting a domestic brokerage as the lead underwriter for the offer, he said.
The company, based in Zhongwei in northwestern Ningxia province, aims to use the proceeds to upgrade the quality of its core product -- writing paper, the official said.
After the offer, Meili will have total share capital of 124 million shares, consisting of 50 million state shares, 14 million legal person shares, 54 million A shares and six million staff shares.
Meili expects after-tax profits of more than 30 million yuan for 1996 against 20 million yuan in 1995, the official said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
